form.description: FLOX sends the events you pick to the ad platform server-side, matched to the ad click, so the platform can optimize delivery. The pixel fires for clicks that went through a stream set it is attached to.

validation.nameMin: Name must be at least 2 characters
validation.pixelIdMax: Pixel ID must be at most 80 characters

form.accessTokenSaved: Saved — ends in {{last4}}. Type to replace
form.accessTokenHint: Stored encrypted and never shown again.
form.testEventCodeHint: Events go to the platform's test view instead of live data. Clear it to go live.
form.urlHint: Called with GET for every event. {status} is the event name below.
form.eventNamesHint: What each event is reported as. Empty uses the platform standard event shown.

list.title: Pixels
list.emptyDescription: Add a conversion pixel to feed ad-platform optimization.

rowActions.archiveConfirmDescription: Archived pixels stop sending new events. This can be reversed later.

deliveries.title: Deliveries
deliveries.description: The last 100 events sent to the platform and how it answered. Updates every 15 seconds.
deliveries.emptyDescription: Events appear here once a click through an attached stream set reaches a selected event.

testEvent.title: Test event
testEvent.descriptionTestMode: Sends one made-up event to {{platform}} now. A test event code is set, so it goes to the platform's test tool (Test Events), not to your statistics.
testEvent.descriptionReal: Sends one made-up event to {{platform}} now. Without a test event code {{platform}} counts it as a real event — you will be asked to confirm.
testEvent.noEvents: Choose the events this pixel reports first.
testEvent.noPermission: You don't have permission to do this
testEvent.savedSettings: Uses the pixel's saved settings — save your changes first. The send appears in the delivery log below.
testEvent.sentTestMode: Look for it in {{platform}}'s test tool (Test Events).
testEvent.sentReal: {{platform}} accepted it as a real event.
testEvent.confirmDescription: {{platform}} will count this {{event}} as a real event in your statistics: no test event code is set (Snapchat and generic pixels have none). It has a test click id and, for a conversion, a value of 1.00 USD.
